invariant.harness_neutral: It names no event, payload field, tool, env var or file path of one agent harness; what a harness provides is in `needs:`.
invariant.domain_truth: document-invariant: it states a domain truth, not an implementation mechanism.
invariant.violable: document-invariant: the system could get it wrong and it matters (not a restated schema).
invariant.always_true: document-invariant: an always-true condition, not a narrated runtime sequence.
invariant.observable: A promise a rule author or the person running the agent can observe and relies on, not a hidden mechanism.
invariant.mentions_complete: document-invariant: every entity and every field of the entity catalog that the predicate constrains or reads is written as that entry's typed mention where the predicate first refers to it, and nowhere under another wording (a synonym, a paraphrase, a plain `Entity.field`); after its mention, a later reference by the thing's own name (`its kind`, `the value`) or a pronoun is fine. A test it applies to a thing (starts with, is equal to, is named, is an `-x` word, is an entry of a table) names the field it reads where two fields could answer it (a Word's text and its value), and a relation it uses between two things (the command of an Invocation) is one a field or a doc defines. A field that is read only through another field's doc, or an invariant cited by id, needs no mention here. On a fail, quote the words and the token to use.
invariant.no_missing_field: document-invariant: Every concept it constrains or reads that is a value of the domain matches an entry of the catalog; a concept that matches none is a field the entity model is missing. On a fail, name the concept and the entity it belongs on.
invariant.concrete: document-invariant: it draws its own boundary, a mechanical condition two readers apply alike to say whether an input is covered; inside it no word can be stretched and every list is closed. An unclear or uncheckable boundary fails; a case it leaves out does not.
invariant.decidable: document-invariant: it asks only for what a program can decide; where exactness would need running the domain's rules without limit, its boundary stops short of that or it states what is reported there.
invariant.terms_defined_once: document-invariant: a term several invariants rely on is defined once (an entity, a field's doc or enum, an invariant) and cited, not re-worded here.
invariant.one_owner: document-invariant: an effect it decides on a tracked value is not also decided by another invariant (cited by id instead of restated); an effect no invariant decides is no finding.
invariant.entity_rules: document-entity, as it bears on an invariant: each field it mentions is used as its doc defines it; a bound, format or enum on one field's own value is on the field (constraint_expr or enum), not here; a reference to another entity goes through a field's type; it does not contradict or redefine a cited entity's or field's doc; where it states that a value is absent or unknown, it follows that field's doc.

entity.domain_facts: document-entity: every field carries a domain fact, not a storage artifact.
entity.constraints_on_field: document-entity: a value constraint is in constraint_expr or enum, not prose.
entity.enum_shape: document-entity: an enum field is a string type plus an enum array.
entity.reference_by_type: document-entity: a reference to another entity is the field's type.
entity.docs_define: document-entity: docs define the construct, never state a rule.
entity.concrete: document-invariant's concreteness, as it bears on a doc: a test the doc defines for invariants to rely on (what an option, a call, a move, a stretch is) names the field it reads where the thing it tests has two that could answer it (a Word's text and its value), and two readers apply it alike.
entity.domain_concept: document-entity: a domain concept, not a wire format.
entity.once_per_domain: document-entity: it exists once per domain, and restates no other entity of the catalog: no field of it repeats a field of another entity under a doc of its own; an entity that is one kind of another reaches it through a field's type.
entity.closed_absence: document-entity: a field that may be absent says what absence means; a case of absence the doc states is stated by a closed rule; a case it leaves to invariants, or leaves unstated, is no finding. A per-item field keeps its meaning when one source item yields several.
